memory_representation_ablation.protocol: RoboCasa365 Target-100% Composite-Seen; 16 tasks; paper-reported matched setup
memory_representation_ablation.metrics: success_rate_pct; MC@25/50/75; max_progress_pct; path_weighted_progress_length_pct; ordered_progress_score_pct; unordered_progress_score_pct
memory_representation_ablation.interpretation: The joint task-state trajectory with both subtask and object-state supervision plus future queries leads this ablation; current-state-only is worse than no-memory on terminal success. This is paper evidence, not an independently reproduced result.

benchmarks.physical_scope: Galbot G1, fixed base, waist rotation between pickup and placement tables; not mobile-base navigation qualification.
benchmarks.claim_ceiling: paper-reported result; small real-world trial count and bounded task; not a general deployment claim

rules: freeze exact upstream protocol, artifacts, policy identity and resource budget before evaluation
report per-task results, confidence intervals, missing cases and failures
no safety failure can be offset by task success
no simulation result is promoted to physical evidence

targets.randomized_robustness: reduce the matched baseline C2C-to-C2R degradation by at least 25%
targets.memory_utility: at least +15 percentage points on a preregistered memory-required subset versus matched memoryless/raw-history baselines, with <=2 percentage-point regression on memory-irrelevant controls
targets.recoverable_fault_recovery: at least 90% safe recovery on a bounded, preregistered recoverable-fault suite
targets.invalid_dispatch: zero invalid, expired, vetoed, duplicate or out-of-order commands reach the controller sink
targets.traceability: 100% of qualification claims bind exact article/configuration/protocol/instrument evidence

non_claims: No Luminous benchmark has been executed by recording this source snapshot.
No SOTA superiority, physical qualification, safety certification or production readiness is implied.
A credential signature or content digest does not prove the physical event or measurement is true.
MOST's paper-reported memory-ablation results are not reproduced or independently verified by Luminous.
